# Channel Growth + Commerce Operations

### Powering the future of commerce

Rithum helps brands and retailers list, market, and optimize products to sell across all major
commerce channels, empowering fast, cost-effective fulfillment and delivery for every order.

Get started

## Rithum for brands

#### Turn more sales channels into scalable revenue

Rithum empowers brands to grow across leading marketplaces without sacrificing control. You can
manage your product content, pricing, and performance all in one place. Launch retail media
campaigns that actually drive results and gain real-time insights into which SKUs, ads, and listings
are delivering the most impact.

### Tap into new sales channels

Expand into new sales channels and manage product listings centrally across 600+ marketplaces in the
Rithum network. Plus, ensure full compliance with each channel’s unique listing standards.

[ Marketplace Listings ][53]

### Simplify your inventory management

Eliminate manual errors and stay in sync across warehouses, marketplaces, and sales channels with a
centralized, accurate view of your inventory.

[ Inventory Management ][54]

### Protect your product listings and maximize margins

Dynamically route orders to the best fulfillment centers, consolidate system integrations, and get
visibility into performance from a single, unified platform.

[ Order Management ][55]

### Run campaigns across top retailers

Scale campaign execution, apply product-level data, automate bidding and keyword strategies, and
connect ad spend to ROI with retailer-verified performance insights.

[ Retail Media Advertising    ][56]

## AI that's more than just hype

### Learn more about RithumIQ

Our AI engine accelerates growth, boosts margins, and simplifies operations.

[ Learn more ][57]

## Rithum for retailers

#### Expand selection and profit without carrying more inventory

With Rithum, retailers can launch curated third-party marketplaces while maintaining full control
over who sells, what they offer, and how orders are fulfilled. You can own the shipping experience
using retailer-supplied labels and provide customers with reliable delivery dates they can trust.

### Accelerate dropshipping operations

Manage direct supplier fulfillment with the same standards, visibility, and efficiency as owned
inventory.

[ Dropship ][58]

### Create private marketplaces with select sellers

Discover ideal brand partners to expand your product catalog and scale ecommerce profitability.

[ Private Marketplaces ][59]

### Optimize delivery performance 

Improve fulfillment costs while providing customers accurate, reliable shipping and delivery
timeframes.

[ Delivery Date Prediction ][60]

### Simplify complexity with insights

Improve supplier performance, protect your customer experience, and scale with confidence through
in-depth reporting and collaborative data views.

[ Commerce Insights ][61]

## Why Rithum

#### The network effect

Rithum is the global leader in commerce, powering a connected ecosystem of products and solutions
for brands, suppliers, and retailers—unifying the ecommerce journey from catalog to consumer.

With proprietary supply chain data and shared performance insights, we help you scale profitably,
reduce complexity, and deliver exceptional consumer experiences across every channel.

[ Learn more ][62]

## Trusted by the world's top global brands and retailers

[ Explore our case studies ][63]

## The Rithum Difference

#### Your trusted advisor

What sets Rithum apart isn’t just our platform—it’s the people behind it. Our comprehensive services
team functions as a true extension of your business. From onboarding and strategy to day-to-day
optimization, our experts work alongside your team to help you get the most out of every connection,
campaign, and channel. Whether you’re a startup or a global enterprise, we make it easy to
integrate, scale, and grow with confidence.

### The future of commerce is changing fast. Let's shape it together.

Whatever your goals, we’re here to help you refine your strategy and get there faster.
Get started

## Commercial EV Chargers

**Chargers for any business, of any size.** To prepare any location – from public to private, from
hotels to workplaces, apartments to condos – Blink Charging offers solutions that are fast,

[Shop Products][11]

**Blink is here to guide you every step of the way** with custom, scalable, EV infrastructure plans

## Residential EV Chargers

Be the preferred choice in the neighborhood by offering a sought-after amenity, boosting your

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

## About Elevatoz

Elevatoz helps enterprises build stronger channel ecosystems through loyalty, traceability,
anti-counterfeiting, and engagement systems backed by technology and program execution. We work
across distributed sales environments where visibility is limited, channel relationships are
fragmented, and business performance depends on consistent participation beyond primary billing.
From onboarding and communication to rewards, fulfilment, analytics, and governance, we bring the
moving parts together into one unified operating model.

[ Learn More ][48]

# Solutions Built for Channel Performance

Elevatoz brings together loyalty, traceability, anti-counterfeiting, engagement, analytics, and
fulfilment within one connected ecosystem. Businesses can deploy one solution or run multiple
programs together without creating operational fragmentation.

[Channel Loyalty Software Dashboard UI]

### Channel Loyalty

Program Design

Build point structures, schemes, tiers, and reward logic aligned to business goals.

Partner Activity Tracking

Capture sales-linked actions, scans, referrals, and participation signals across the channel.

Program Execution

Run onboarding, communication, rewards, and approvals through one structured workflow.

[Traceability System Dashboard UI]

### Traceability

Product-Level Visibility

Assign unique identities to products and track movement across distribution layers.

Secondary and Tertiary Tracking

Capture scan-based events beyond primary billing for better downstream visibility.

Flow Monitoring

Analyse movement patterns, exceptions, and reporting signals through one system.

[Anti Counterfeiting UI]

### Anti-Counterfeiting

Authentication Workflows

Enable controlled product verification at relevant touchpoints.

Verification Visibility

Track authentication attempts, outcomes, and location-linked signals.

Response Management

Trigger automated responses, escalations, and reporting where needed.

[Influencer Engagement System UI]

### Influencer Engagement

Participation Design

Structure incentive-led engagement for key channel influencers.

Activity Capture

Record field participation, submissions, and on-ground engagement events.

Controlled Execution

Use approval workflows, role-based access, and reporting to manage program quality.

[Analytics and Intelligence Dashboard]

### Analytics & Intelligence

Performance Visibility

Define KPIs, view participation trends, and monitor program movement.

Data Consolidation

Bring cross-system event data together into one reporting layer.

Actionable Reporting

Deliver dashboards, alerts, and periodic performance outputs for business teams.

[Rewards and Fulfilment Management System]

### Rewards & Fulfilment

Reward Governance

Manage eligibility, catalogue logic, approvals, and redemption rules.

Redemption Tracking

Monitor requests, fulfilment status, and completion visibility.

Actionable Reporting

Coordinate order flow, vendor management, and delivery operations at scale.

Program performance is measured through structured event data consolidated across systems.

## Empowering Leaders. Driving Results. Together.

 

 

Success in business doesn’t come with a manual — especially in today’s fast-evolving world. But
you’re not alone. Countless executives have faced the same challenges you’re navigating, from
crafting winning strategies to investing in cutting-edge technologies and attracting the customers
who matter most. The difference? They partnered with Forrester.

Through a **unique continuous guidance model** that blends research, consulting, and live events, we
ensure you stay ahead of every curve. Equipped with the latest trends, innovations, and data, our
tailored interactions empower you to act swiftly and decisively.

With insights drawn from surveying over **500,000 consumers, executives, and tech leaders
annually**, Forrester consultants and analysts are unrivaled in understanding the challenges you
face. Whatever hurdles you encounter, we’ve seen them — and solved them.


 

Learn more about how Forrester can help you stay ahead of the curve.

day.

Built on Forrester’s proprietary research and governed by transparency and trust, Forrester AI helps
teams move faster, stay aligned, and make confident decisions when it matters most. Forrester AI
delivers expertise into the moments where decisions get made — for every level of the organization.

[Explore Forrester AI In Teams][172]

sustainability and trust.

### Functional Acceleration

Helping teams move critical initiatives forward faster with actionable research, tools, and expert
guidance.

### Individual Advancement

Helping professionals grow at every stage of their career through certifications, events, and
executive partnership.

Rely on Forrester for value in all seasons and at all moments — from strategy to execution to career
growth.

[Learn More][173]

**Sixty-one of the Fortune 100 trust us to provide strategic clarity, operational alignment, and
innovative solutions that accelerate growth.**

* We collect directly from career pages - we take vacancies straight from company sites, including

  plain-language request.
* Telegram alerts - save as many filters as you want and get notified across all of them.
  Deduplication works here too: if a vacancy matches several of your filters, it arrives once, not
  as duplicates.

## Still curious? Here are some quick answers to help clear things up

[

][91]
What makes Introw headless?

With Introw, you and your partners work where you already work. Work from inside HubSpot,
Salesforce, Slack, Teams, or your own AI assistant, and everything syncs back to the CRM.

How are we different from a traditional PRM?

Traditional PRMs are a standalone portal with limited CRM integration, so every partner has to log
in and adoption stays low. Introw is CRM-native and headless, so you set up in minutes and you meet
your partners where they already are.

How does Introw integrate with my CRM?

Introw syncs two-way with HubSpot or Salesforce, so your CRM stays the single source of truth.
Partner activity, deals, and attribution flow both ways in real time, with no second system to
reconcile. And you and your partners can work from inside the CRM itself.

Is Introw AI-native?

Yes. The full Introw platform is AI-native, and it even connects to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI
assistants through MCP, so you can work from your favorite AI tool without ever logging in to the
portal.

## Start scaling your partner program

Stop managing partners in spreadsheets. Launch a program that runs inside your CRM, meets partners
where they are, and uses AI to handle the work you don't have time for.

What makes Introw headless?

With Introw, you and your partners work where you already work. Work from inside HubSpot,
Salesforce, Slack, Teams, or your own AI assistant, and everything syncs back to the CRM.

How are we different from a traditional PRM?

Traditional PRMs are a standalone portal with limited CRM integration, so every partner has to log
in and adoption stays low. Introw is CRM-native and headless, so you set up in minutes and you meet
your partners where they already are.

How does Introw integrate with my CRM?

Introw syncs two-way with HubSpot or Salesforce, so your CRM stays the single source of truth.
Partner activity, deals, and attribution flow both ways in real time, with no second system to
reconcile. And you and your partners can work from inside the CRM itself.

Is Introw AI-native?

Yes. The full Introw platform is AI-native, and it even connects to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI
assistants through MCP, so you can work from your favorite AI tool without ever logging in to the
portal.

## FAQ: Partner Management Platform

Here are some common questions about our Partner Management software

### How long does it take to set up the Partner Management software? Can we get started quickly?

Absolutely! We've designed our Partner Management Platform for rapid deployment. You can typically
set it up in less than a day and start running your partner programs almost immediately. There are
no lengthy, complex implementation processes involved, so you can hit the ground running and see
value quickly.

### How does the CRM synchronisation work with your Partner Management Platform, and which CRMs do
### you support?

Our Partner Management software is built for robust connectivity with your existing sales tools. We
provide deep, bi-directional integration for several leading CRMs, including Salesforce, HubSpot,
Pipedrive, and Attio. This ensures that data such as leads, opportunities, and account information
related to partners is consistently updated and accurate across both your Partner Management
Platform and CRM systems, providing a unified view and streamlining workflows between your sales and
partner teams.

### Does our partner management team need separate seats in our existing CRM if we use your Partner
### Management Platform?

No, they do not. Your partner team will not require additional seats in your CRM specifically for
managing partner activities. Everything they need for partner relationship management, from
onboarding and communication to performance tracking and resource sharing, can be done directly
within our Partner Management software. This centralises partner operations and can lead to cost
savings on CRM licenses.

### Will our internal sales team need to get additional seats or licenses for the Partner Management
### Platform?

No, your sales team does not need additional seats in the PRM. We understand that sales teams often
have their preferred environments and workflows. They can continue to work primarily within their
existing CRM. Our Partner Management software is designed to integrate seamlessly, ensuring that
relevant partner-related data is synced without requiring your sales reps to learn or operate within

## One Platform to Power Every Partner Program

What if your partner ecosystem is your company's most valuable, yet least-tapped, asset? JourneyBee
provides the key to finally unlock it, transforming disjointed manual tasks into a self-perpetuating
engine for growth and value.

[Referral Partners Icon]

### Referral Partners

Benefit from a simple, automated portal to submit leads in seconds. They gain instant visibility
into lead status and receive real-time notifications as their referral progresses.

[Reseller Partners Icon]

### Reseller Partners

Leverage automated deal registration to instantly protect their opportunities and avoid channel
conflict. A process-driven system simplifies quoting and ordering.

[Channel (Distributors) Icon]

### Channel (Distributors)

Gain a top-down view of their entire reseller network. Automation allows them to manage and
distribute leads, broadcast updates, and track collective pipeline.

[OEM Partners Icon]

### OEM Partners

Receive automated updates on product changes, API documentation, and technical specifications.
Streamline collaboration on joint marketing efforts.

[Affiliates Icon]

### Affiliates

Automatically equipped with unique tracking links, marketing assets, and a real-time dashboard to
monitor clicks, conversions, and commissions.

[Aggregators Icon]

### Aggregators

Use automation to efficiently manage a diverse portfolio of products and services from a single
vendor portal. Simplify bundling and tracking across product lines.

[Integrators (SIs) Icon]

### Integrators (SIs)

Benefit from automated onboarding that includes technical training, sandbox access, and
certifications. Access knowledge base for efficient implementations.

[ISVs (Independent Software Vendors) Icon]

### ISVs (Independent Software Vendors)

Engage in a structured, automated process for technical integration and app certification.
Facilitate automated lead sharing for joint opportunities.

## The Difference Between Having Partners and Growing With Them

### Before Journeybee

Key features:
* Siloed CRM Data with no real-time visibility or collaborative access for partners.
* Static Partner Portals with Generic, uninviting portals that were rarely used.
* Zero Meaningful Engagement from Partners
* Manual Onboarding, lead sharing, and deals handled via email and spreadsheets.

VS

### With Journeybee

Key features:
* Personalised and on-demand access to the training and resources partners need to sell.
* Increased Activity with Custom Portal experiences that partners actually want to use.
* Engagement in Digital Sales Rooms with shared space for partners and internal teams to collaborate
  on deals.
* A single source of truth to track performance and drive mutual growth.

VS

## The Monthly Buzz

Stay updated on all things partnerships with insights, guides, and best practices delivered straight
to your inbox.

## Where Team Silos End and Revenue Begins

[Partner Portal Icon]

### Partner Teams

Building a great partner program shouldn't be chaotic. We give you one place to manage everything
and automate the repetitive tasks, freeing you to focus on the strong partner relationships that
actually drive your business forward.

[CRM Integration Icon]

### Sales Teams

What if your sales team knew what your partners were doing, without asking? We show them live
partner updates right inside their sales software. This prevents reps from accidentally chasing the
same customers and helps them team up with partners to close deals faster.

[LMS CMS Icon]

### Partner Marketing Teams

Every marketing dollar should come with proof. We give you the tools to easily create campaigns with
your partners and see exactly how many new leads and sales result from them, so you can finally
invest in marketing that you know gets results.

## FAQ: Partner Management Platform

Here are some common questions about our Partner Management software

### How long does it take to set up the Partner Management software? Can we get started quickly?

Absolutely! We've designed our Partner Management Platform for rapid deployment. You can typically
set it up in less than a day and start running your partner programs almost immediately. There are
no lengthy, complex implementation processes involved, so you can hit the ground running and see
value quickly.

### How does the CRM synchronisation work with your Partner Management Platform, and which CRMs do
### you support?

Our Partner Management software is built for robust connectivity with your existing sales tools. We
provide deep, bi-directional integration for several leading CRMs, including Salesforce, HubSpot,
Pipedrive, and Attio. This ensures that data such as leads, opportunities, and account information
related to partners is consistently updated and accurate across both your Partner Management
Platform and CRM systems, providing a unified view and streamlining workflows between your sales and
partner teams.

### Does our partner management team need separate seats in our existing CRM if we use your Partner
### Management Platform?

No, they do not. Your partner team will not require additional seats in your CRM specifically for
managing partner activities. Everything they need for partner relationship management, from
onboarding and communication to performance tracking and resource sharing, can be done directly
within our Partner Management software. This centralises partner operations and can lead to cost
savings on CRM licenses.

### Will our internal sales team need to get additional seats or licenses for the Partner Management
### Platform?

No, your sales team does not need additional seats in the PRM. We understand that sales teams often
have their preferred environments and workflows. They can continue to work primarily within their
existing CRM. Our Partner Management software is designed to integrate seamlessly, ensuring that
relevant partner-related data is synced without requiring your sales reps to learn or operate within
a new platform for their daily tasks.

### How is your Partner Management Platform priced?

Our pricing model is straightforward and designed for scalability. We charge on a per-month or
annual basis, with plans starting from €499 for 3 users and unlimited partners. This allows you to
adjust your investment based on the size and needs of your partner management team.

#### What is Partner Relationship Management (PRM) software?
#### ][91]

relationships with their partners, such as distributors, resellers, and other third-party entities.

between the company and its partners.

change and evolve.

tools to integrate in other ways.

## Partner Programs Don't Fail.
## Partner Tech Stacks Do.

Most organizations run partner programs on a fragmented partner technology stack. One system for
PRM. Another for partner marketing. Separate tools for enablement, training, and reporting. As you
expand to manage resellers, ISVs, influencers, and alliances in a modern ecosystem, this
fragmentation is only accelerated. None of the tools talk to each other.
* The result is predictable
* Partners disengage
* Partner managers chase updates
* Partner marketing teams push content that never gets used

Mindmatrix replaces fragmented tools with a single

### AI-Powered Partner Operating System

where AI, data, & execution are unified. One system that works for partners, partner account
managers, partner marketing teams, & partner program & experience owners.

## Partner Marketing
## Automation (TCMA)
## That Actually Gets Used

### TO • THROUGH • WITH • FOR

Most partner marketing platforms distribute assets and hope partners execute. Mindmatrix closes the
gap between hope, content, and action.

#### For Partner Marketing Managers:

AI turns a single corporate campaign into thousands of localized, co-branded partner campaigns that
are ready to execute, in seconds.

#### For Partners:

Automated execution across email, social, video, and local campaigns without needing marketing
expertise.

#### Concierge Execution:

When partners don't have the time, our human team and our AI, execute on their behalf. Partner
participation is no longer optional or aspirational. It's easy.

[Partner Portal, partner dashboard] [ellipse]

## AI-Powered Partner
## Relationship Management
## (PRM)

### Think • Build • Operate

Traditional PRM software acts as a system of record. Names, tiers, documents, and little action.
Mindmatrix transforms PRM into an AI-driven system of execution and outcomes.

#### For Partner Account Managers:

Real-time pipeline visibility without manual reporting. Automated onboarding, deal registration,
tiering, and multi-partner deal workflows driven by rules, automation, and AI signals.

#### For Partners:

An AI-guided, self-service experience that feels like a home base and operates in the way that
partners like to work. Partners see what matters, complete what's required, and get back to selling
faster.

[Channel partner marketing software, Channel manager dashboard] [ellipse]

## Channel Sales Enablement
## Built Into the Platform

### Enable • Guide • Close

Channel sales enablement shouldn't live in a separate LMS, sales platform, marketplace, locator, or
content repository.
Mindmatrix embeds enablement and selling directly into the partner workflow, with AI-guided
sequences and solution locators that help partners progress deals from first conversation to close.

#### For Partner Managers:

Ensure partners complete training, certifications, and sales readiness milestones, then guide them
through structured sales sequences that move deals forward.

#### For Partners:

Contextual access to sales plays, sequences, solution locators, and deal guidance based on what
they're selling and where they are in the deal cycle.

[sales playbook, sales automation] [ellipse]

## Partner Ecosystem
## Orchestration, Not Just
## Channel Management

### Discover • Connect • Win

Modern ecosystems include resellers, referral partners, alliances, ISVs, GSI's and influencers.
Mindmatrix orchestrates all partner types in one system.

#### Marketplace & Discovery:

Partners can find, configure, and quote solutions alongside their own services. This includes
intelligent **Solution and Partner Locators** to easily match customer needs with the right
ecosystem partners and offerings.

#### Ecosystem intelligence:

AI identifies influence revenue, collaboration opportunities, and which partners should work
together to win accounts. This intelligence enables seamless collaboration and joint selling across
complex deals for maximum win-rates and increased partner-led revenue.

[marketing playbook, marketing automation] [ellipse]

### Get on the Bridge to Success

Learn more about how Bridge can help you succeed
by enabling your sales ecosystems effectively.

## Software Alone Doesn't
## Drive  Adoption. Execution Does.

Mindmatrix combines software with [unlimited services and support][89] to turn partner strategy into
execution. Adoption, engagement, and results are engineered, not left to chance.

### Unlimited Support

Configuration, optimization, partner assistance, and ongoing support are included. When partners
struggle to execute, our team and AI step in to keep programs moving.

### Built to Scale

From early-stage partner programs to global partner ecosystems, the platform and services evolve as
your business grows, without forcing you to add tools or headcount.

## It's the Foundation.

AI runs across [Partner Relationship Management (PRM)][90], [Partner Marketing Automation
(TCMA),][91] [Channel Sales Enablement,][92] and [Partner Ecosystem Orchestration][93] in a single
AI-powered partner operating system.

Identify which partners are ready to close, which are stalling, and where intervention is needed.

### Conversational Guidance

A 24/7 AI assistant removes friction for partners and managers. No searching. No guessing.

Instantaneously create and localize co-branded marketing campaigns, sales plays, and training
materials, eliminating content bottlenecks and driving speed-to-market.

04

### Admin Automation

Intelligent AI agents automate time-consuming administrative tasks, including deal registration,
data cleaning, tier management, and many other tasks that free up Partner Account Managers and

Most organizations run partner programs on a fragmented partner technology stack. One system for
PRM. Another for partner marketing. Separate tools for enablement, training, and reporting. As you
expand to manage resellers, ISVs, influencers, and alliances in a modern ecosystem, this
fragmentation is only accelerated. None of the tools talk to each other.

* Partners disengage
* Partner managers chase updates
* Partner marketing teams push content that never gets used

Mindmatrix replaces fragmented tools with a single

### AI-Powered Partner Operating System

where AI, data, & execution are unified. One system that works for partners, partner account
managers, partner marketing teams, & partner program & experience owners.

Most partner marketing platforms distribute assets and hope partners execute. Mindmatrix closes the
gap between hope, content, and action.

expertise.

participation is no longer optional or aspirational. It's easy.

## The heavy cost of generic CRM software

### The generic tax

Most teams pay Salesforce or HubSpot large per seat fees for features they never use. You bend your
entire business process to fit their generic software database.

### The growing bill

Maintaining these systems requires constant admin overhead and workarounds. When your team grows,
your annual bill climbs even if your workflow stays the same.

The shift

Building custom software used to be too expensive for a single team. Now, an experienced team and a
tightly scoped build make custom CRM development highly cost effective.

## How it works

01

### Scope your use case

We study how your team uses your current CRM. We map your fields, pipelines, automations, and

02

### Build your custom CRM

Our engineering team builds your database and interface. You get a CRM designed for your process
with zero unused modules.

03

### Migrate your data

We import your records, histories, and pipelines from your old system. We ensure the switch happens
without losing any of your existing work.

04

### Run and support the system

We host and maintain your CRM on our managed servers or your own infrastructure. Our team stays on
to handle ongoing changes and support.

## Why teams switch

### Lower annual costs

Teams typically cut their CRM spend by 5x to 10x. You pay an ongoing yearly fee for development and
hosting with zero per seat licenses.

### Perfect process fit

Your software matches your actual workflow. We only build the pipelines, reports, and integrations
that your team actually uses every day.

### Run it on your infrastructure

You can host the system on your own infrastructure to meet strict compliance and data policies.

### Seamless data migration

We handle the entire migration process. Your historical records from Salesforce, HubSpot, or other
systems move over completely.

### Experienced human support

You work directly with an experienced development team. You do not have to wait in a generic
customer support queue or hire a reseller.

### Flexible integrations

We connect your new CRM with the business tools you already use. We choose and configure these
integrations during the scoping phase.

Wispro is a voice-to-writing tool designed to convert spoken language into clean, usable text
directly within your workflow. It caters to individuals who want to streamline their writing process
by leveraging their voice instead of typing. The primary purpose of Wispro is to offer a flexible
and intelligent way to generate written content, adapting to the user's natural speaking patterns.
The problem Wispro addresses is the time and effort typically involved in typing out thoughts,
ideas, or instructions. Many existing speech-to-text applications offer basic transcription but lack
the adaptability to truly integrate with a user's unique thinking and communication style. This can
lead to inefficient workflows and a disconnect between spoken ideas and written output. Wispro
offers three distinct modes to cater to various needs. Basic Mode provides a straightforward
transcription, capturing every word exactly as spoken, which is useful for verbatim records or when
precise speech capture is paramount. Smart Mode goes a step further by intelligently cutting out
filler words, hesitations, and rambling, then formatting the speech into coherent, polished prose.
This mode is ideal for drafting emails, reports, or any content where a clean and professional tone
is desired. Command Mode is a unique feature that allows users to turn spoken instructions into
finished written content. By simply stating a command, such as "write me an email about X" or "draft
a tweet about Y," Wispro generates the requested text on the spot. This mode is explicitly triggered
by a hotkey, distinguishing it from the other modes and ensuring that the application understands
when it's receiving an instruction rather than content to be transcribed. Another key aspect of
Wispro is its emphasis on personalization and flexibility. Unlike other tools with fixed presets for
different tones or contexts, Wispro allows users to define their own writing styles and rules in
their own words. This means the Smart Mode's cleanup and formatting are not generic but are tailored
to the user's specific instructions, effectively reshaping rambling thoughts into a personally
defined style. Wispro operates by utilizing advanced AI models, specifically mentioning the
integration with Whisper large-v3 for its multilingual capabilities and Groq API for processing. The
tool is designed to be set up quickly, often within minutes, and runs on the user's own Groq API
key. This approach ensures that the service is free to use, as Groq's free tier is generally
sufficient for daily usage without hitting limits, eliminating the need for subscriptions or hidden
premium tiers. The benefits for users include significant time savings, increased productivity, and
a more natural way to create written content. By reducing the reliance on typing and offering
intelligent text generation, Wispro empowers users to express their ideas more fluidly and
efficiently, transforming spoken thoughts into ready-to-use text with minimal friction. Concrete use
cases for Wispro include drafting social media posts like tweets by simply dictating the message,
generating entire email drafts or replies based on spoken instructions, and quickly transcribing
meeting notes or brainstorming sessions. It can also be used for creating blog post outlines or even
full articles by speaking through the content and letting Wispro refine it. Currently, Wispro is
available for Windows, with plans for more platforms, including a Mac version, in the roadmap. The

directly within your workflow. It caters to individuals who want to streamline their writing process
by leveraging their voice instead of typing. The primary purpose of Wispro is to offer a flexible
and intelligent way to generate written content, adapting to the user's natural speaking patterns.
The problem Wispro addresses is the time and effort typically involved in typing out thoughts,
ideas, or instructions. Many existing speech-to-text applications offer basic transcription but lack
the adaptability to truly integrate with a user's unique thinking and communication style. This can
lead to inefficient workflows and a disconnect between spoken ideas and written output. Wispro
offers three distinct modes to cater to various needs. Basic Mode provides a straightforward
transcription, capturing every word exactly as spoken, which is useful for verbatim records or when
precise speech capture is paramount. Smart Mode goes a step further by intelligently cutting out
filler words, hesitations, and rambling, then formatting the speech into coherent, polished prose.

repetitive tasks over and over.

Your AEs don't have time to be learning a special sales process for how to work with partners.

Your tools don't tell you when a partner or an opportunity needs attention - and you're forced to be
reactive.

## There's a better way. It's Superglue.

We guide you, your AEs, and your partners through the co-selling process using workflow automations.

## Automate repetitive tasks in your partner workflows.

Our workflow builder lets you set up automated actions that are triggered by deal updates in your
partner tech stack (CRM, Crossbeam or Reveal, PRM).
* Notify partner managers when partners or deals need attention.
* Let partner managers trigger pre-drafted, AI-powered emails.
* Tell your AEs when partners can help source and close deals.

## Get your AEs to follow your co-selling process - without having to train them.

Our automated Slack alerts not only tell your AEs when partners can help them with deals - We also
make it easy for them to ask for your help in engaging a partner and moving a deal forward.

## Get access to over 30 pre-built partner automation workflows.

Our partner automation blueprints give you a best-practice structure to follow for all parts of your
partner program including onboarding, enablement, nurturing, portal adoption, co-selling, and more -
so you can automate more of your partner process, while still delivering a personalized experience
for your partners.

Create engagement journeys from proven blueprints or just build your own from scratch.

Scale hyper-personalized partner experiences and drive more revenue, faster.

## Novalab SEO Agency FAQs

### Is SEO still important with the rise of AI search tools?

SEO is becoming even more important as**[ AI search][76]** platforms prioritize authoritative,
technically sound, and trustworthy sources. Combining traditional SEO with Answer Engine
Optimization helps SaaS brands appear in AI-generated recommendations, opening a new channel of
high-intent discovery that can drive additional customers, recurring revenue, and long-term income.

### How should SaaS companies measure SEO success?

True **[SEO][77] **success is measured by business outcomes rather than vanity metrics. Improvements
in trial sign-ups, demo requests, qualified pipeline, customer acquisition efficiency, and monthly
recurring revenue provide the clearest indication that SEO is contributing to sustainable growth and
increasing overall income.

### Can SEO lower customer acquisition cost for SaaS companies?

Yes. Once organic rankings are established, **[SEO][78] **delivers a steady stream of qualified
visitors without the need to pay for every click or impression. Over time, this reduces customer
acquisition cost while increasing predictable recurring revenue and long-term income, making SEO one
of the most efficient growth channels for SaaS.

### Why is technical SEO so important for SaaS websites?

**[Technical SEO][79]** ensures that search engines can properly crawl, understand, and trust a SaaS
website. Strong site performance, clear architecture, correct indexation, and healthy Core Web
Vitals allow product and content pages to rank more easily, which directly influences visibility,
lead generation, and revenue growth.

### Does blogging still work for SaaS SEO?

Blogging can be highly effective when it is closely connected to the product and guides readers
toward meaningful next steps, such as exploring features, viewing use-case pages, or starting a
trial. Content created only for traffic rarely converts, but product-led **[content][80]** that
aligns with real user intent can consistently generate qualified leads and long-term income.

### Which keywords are most important for SaaS growth?

The keywords that matter most are those used by people who are already evaluating software or
preparing to make a purchase decision. Searches related to best software in a category, competitor
alternatives, specific use cases, pricing, integrations, and comparisons tend to generate the
highest-quality traffic and lead directly to new trials, customers, and recurring revenue
[**growth**][81].

### How long does SEO take to show results for a SaaS company?

Most [**SaaS businesses**][82] begin to see early traction within three to six months, while
meaningful impact on pipeline and recurring revenue typically appears between six and twelve months.
Because SEO compounds over time, it frequently becomes the most scalable and cost-efficient
acquisition channel compared to paid advertising or outbound efforts.

### What is SaaS SEO, and how is it different from traditional SEO?

[**SaaS SEO**][83] is designed to attract high-intent users who are actively searching for solutions
and are likely to convert into free trials, demo requests, and paying customers. Unlike traditional
SEO, which often focuses only on increasing traffic, SaaS SEO connects technical optimization,
product-focused content, and bottom-of-funnel search intent to drive measurable growth in customers,
recurring revenue, and overall income.

## Novalab SEO Agency FAQs

### Is SEO still important with the rise of AI search tools?

SEO is becoming even more important as**[ AI search][76]** platforms prioritize authoritative,
technically sound, and trustworthy sources. Combining traditional SEO with Answer Engine
Optimization helps SaaS brands appear in AI-generated recommendations, opening a new channel of
high-intent discovery that can drive additional customers, recurring revenue, and long-term income.

### How should SaaS companies measure SEO success?

True **[SEO][77] **success is measured by business outcomes rather than vanity metrics. Improvements
in trial sign-ups, demo requests, qualified pipeline, customer acquisition efficiency, and monthly
recurring revenue provide the clearest indication that SEO is contributing to sustainable growth and
increasing overall income.

### Can SEO lower customer acquisition cost for SaaS companies?

Yes. Once organic rankings are established, **[SEO][78] **delivers a steady stream of qualified
visitors without the need to pay for every click or impression. Over time, this reduces customer
acquisition cost while increasing predictable recurring revenue and long-term income, making SEO one
of the most efficient growth channels for SaaS.

### Why is technical SEO so important for SaaS websites?

**[Technical SEO][79]** ensures that search engines can properly crawl, understand, and trust a SaaS
website. Strong site performance, clear architecture, correct indexation, and healthy Core Web
Vitals allow product and content pages to rank more easily, which directly influences visibility,
lead generation, and revenue growth.

### Does blogging still work for SaaS SEO?

Blogging can be highly effective when it is closely connected to the product and guides readers
toward meaningful next steps, such as exploring features, viewing use-case pages, or starting a
trial. Content created only for traffic rarely converts, but product-led **[content][80]** that
aligns with real user intent can consistently generate qualified leads and long-term income.

### Which keywords are most important for SaaS growth?

The keywords that matter most are those used by people who are already evaluating software or
preparing to make a purchase decision. Searches related to best software in a category, competitor
alternatives, specific use cases, pricing, integrations, and comparisons tend to generate the
highest-quality traffic and lead directly to new trials, customers, and recurring revenue
[**growth**][81].

### How long does SEO take to show results for a SaaS company?

Most [**SaaS businesses**][82] begin to see early traction within three to six months, while
meaningful impact on pipeline and recurring revenue typically appears between six and twelve months.
Because SEO compounds over time, it frequently becomes the most scalable and cost-efficient
acquisition channel compared to paid advertising or outbound efforts.

### What is SaaS SEO, and how is it different from traditional SEO?

[**SaaS SEO**][83] is designed to attract high-intent users who are actively searching for solutions
and are likely to convert into free trials, demo requests, and paying customers. Unlike traditional
SEO, which often focuses only on increasing traffic, SaaS SEO connects technical optimization,
product-focused content, and bottom-of-funnel search intent to drive measurable growth in customers,
recurring revenue, and overall income.

## Web whiteboard for instant collaboration.

# Sketch, brainstorm and share your ideas. No sign-up required.

Whiteboard
* Collaborating in real time
* Saving your work
* Using tools
* How do I share an online whiteboard?
  You can invite anyone to your online whiteboard by clicking on the "share board" button on the top
  right corner of the screen and sharing the board link. With the link they can access your board
  for free without having to sign up.
* How can other people collaborate on the whiteboard?
  Web whiteboard makes it easy to let co-workers, colleagues, or students contribute to your online
  whiteboard in real time. Just share the board link, and you can join and start collaborating.
* Can other users export my online whiteboards?
  Yes. Once you have shared a board with others, they will be able to export it by clicking the
  "Export this board" icon. They can export it either as a JPG or PDF file.
* Can other users draw on and edit the contents of the online whiteboard?
  Yes. Share the Web whiteboard link with anyone, and they will instantly have editing rights. Once
  they access the whiteboard, they will have the same editing rights as the creator of the board. If
  you want to invite people to your project and manage their edit rights, or if you’d like more
  functionalities on your whiteboard, you need to [sign up for the free Miro Plan][1].
* How is my whiteboard saved?
  If you’re a Web whiteboard user, your boards are available for 24 hours. To keep using them after
  that, simply [sign up for a free Miro Plan][2], log in and save your work.
  If you are a registered Miro user, you can easily save your board by clicking on the "Save to my
  boards" button at the center top of the screen.
* How can I create an identical copy of my online whiteboard?
  You can download your board as an image or PDF. Simply click on the "Export this board" icon next
  to the Web whiteboard name in the upper left corner of your screen and select which kind of file
  you would like to save. Please note that if you don’t save or export your board, it will be
  permanently deleted after 24 hours.
* How do I export my online whiteboards?
  Click the "Export this board" icon next to the Web whiteboard name in the top left corner of your
  screen to export your board as an image or PDF (If you don’t save or export your board, it will be
  permanently deleted after 24 hours). Registered Miro users can export their boards by clicking the
  same "Export this board" icon and choose from image, PDF, spreadsheet, embed, and Google Drive
  exporting options.
* How do I delete my online whiteboard?
  The board will be automatically deleted after 24 hours. There is no way to delete a whiteboard in
  Web whiteboard manually.
* How do sticky notes work?
  Web whiteboard’s sticky notes feature gives you a fun, interactive way to brainstorm, take notes,
  and arrange information visually on your online whiteboard. To get started, click the sticky note
  icon on the toolbar or press N on your keyboard.
  You can also add sticky notes by dragging and dropping them right from the toolbar or by clicking
  the board and dragging your cursor holding the left mouse button.
  Double-click anywhere on the board to add text, stickies, or shapes. You can also resize your
  sticky notes and change their colors for better consistency in your whiteboard.
* How do I use a ready-made template on my online whiteboard?
  Web whiteboard has six templates to choose from that let you save time and get started quickly. To
  add a template to your whiteboard, choose templates on the toolbar. If you want, you can sign up
  for Miro and find a greater variety of more than 550 templates in [Miroverse][3].
* Which shapes are available for Web whiteboard boards?
  You can choose from a wide array of shapes to add to your whiteboard, including squares, circles,
  triangles, ovals, quote bubbles, arrows, and brackets.
* How does the Select button work?
  Web whiteboard features a select cursor (the arrow icon at the top of the left toolbar) for
  selecting items on your board, changing their details, including color or size, or adding links,
  as well as for moving those items around the canvas of the whiteboard.
* How does the Pen work?
  The pen tool lets you add (or delete) drawings on your Web whiteboard board. To start, just click
  the pen icon on your left toolbar or press P on the keyboard. Then use presets to switch from one
  color and thickness to another easily. You can use any pen tool on a tablet device: Apple Pencil,
  Surface Pen, Samsung S Pen, etc.
* What are the text options for my online whiteboard?
  There are three simple ways to add text to your Web whiteboard board: you can select text on the
  toolbar or press T on your keyboard, click anywhere on the board and start typing; you can drag
  and drop a text widget from the toolbar right to the board, or you can click anywhere on the board
  and drag your cursor holding the lef

  and drag your cursor holding the left mouse button.
  You’ll have numerous formatting options for your text, including font, font size, text box, border
  color, opacity, and highlighting.
* How do connection lines work on my online whiteboards?
  The connection line tool allows you to link objects on your Web whiteboard board, making it ideal
  for building diagrams and flowcharts. To create a line, select the connection line on the toolbar
  or use the hotkey L, click an object and drag your cursor to another object. You can also select
  an object and click one of the blue dots around it to start drawing a line. It’s easy to customize

* Can I rotate or resize an uploaded file?

  board. Once you place it, you can no longer rotate or resize it, but you can still move it around

  You can add the following kinds of files from your computer or from the web (maximum file size is
  30 MB, full image resolution is 32 MP): images, PDF files, Google Drive documents, and MS Office

## AI-Driven Partner Intelligence for Modern Ecosystems

### [PRM (Partner Relationship Management)][30]

PRM helps manage channel partners by supporting onboarding, training, deal registration, and
performance tracking enabling smoother partner operations and partner-driven sales.

### [Through Channel Marketing Automation (TCMA)][31]

TCMA enables partners to run campaigns, share content, and manage leads through automated,
co-branded marketing programs making partner marketing measurable at scale.

### [Oliver AI][32]

Oliver AI delivers intelligent insights, predictive recommendations, and automated actions to
activate and engage partners.

### [Opensource PRM][33]

A free, customizable PRM offering basic partner management, deal tracking, and collaboration, with
limited partners and integrations compared to full-featured platforms.

### [Marketing automation][34]

Enables MSPs to run automated, personalized marketing campaigns with built-in analytics to improve
efficiency and ROI.

structured programs and automation.

[ What does xAmplify do?
][46]

xAmplify is a partner program management platform that helps B2B companies activate, engage, and
scale their partner ecosystems. Powered by Oliver AI, it turns partner signals into intelligent
actions across onboarding, engagement, and performance.

[ What is Oliver AI?
][47]

Oliver AI is xAmplify’s intelligence layer that continuously analyzes partner behavior, activity,
and performance signals to recommend the right actions at the right time. It helps teams focus on
high-impact partners and opportunities.

[ Do we need large amounts of data to use xAmplify?
][48]

No. xAmplify works with the data you already have. Oliver AI starts generating insights quickly and
becomes smarter over time as more partner activity flows through the platform.

[ Is our partner and program data secure?
][49]

Yes. xAmplify is built with enterprise-grade security, access controls, and data isolation. Customer
data remains private and is never shared or used to train external models.

[ Can xAmplify integrate with our existing systems?
][50]

Yes. xAmplify integrates with CRMs, PRMs, marketing tools, and other partner-related systems to
ensure seamless data flow and minimal disruption to existing workflows.

[ What does xAmplify do?
][46]

xAmplify is a partner program management platform that helps B2B companies activate, engage, and
scale their partner ecosystems. Powered by Oliver AI, it turns partner signals into intelligent
actions across onboarding, engagement, and performance.

[ What is Oliver AI?
][47]

Oliver AI is xAmplify’s intelligence layer that continuously analyzes partner behavior, activity,
and performance signals to recommend the right actions at the right time. It helps teams focus on
high-impact partners and opportunities.

[ Do we need large amounts of data to use xAmplify?
][48]

No. xAmplify works with the data you already have. Oliver AI starts generating insights quickly and
becomes smarter over time as more partner activity flows through the platform.

[ Is our partner and program data secure?
][49]

Yes. xAmplify is built with enterprise-grade security, access controls, and data isolation. Customer
data remains private and is never shared or used to train external models.

[ Can xAmplify integrate with our existing systems?
][50]

Yes. xAmplify integrates with CRMs, PRMs, marketing tools, and other partner-related systems to
ensure seamless data flow and minimal disruption to existing workflows.

Personalization quality 25%

data dimension to the floor, and that floor cascades into the other dimensions. A tool that can't

# Online Whiteboard with Realtime Collaboration

## Virtual online whiteboard with team collaboration

Ziteboard is a lightweight whiteboard website which works on any device: laptops, tablets, mobile
devices – optimized for both iPad's Safari and Google Chrome on laptops.

[START DRAWING NOW][8]

Our service is designed for successful realtime tutoring. We understand the importance of a clean
and easy to use interface to best serve both teachers and students of all ages. By design, this
lightweight yet powerful visual platform aims to provide a simple tool for distance education. Using
such a platform you have infinite space to work on with your student or class in realtime.

## Live Teamwork on Online Whiteboard

[Shared whiteboard to work together.]

Collaborate in real time, wherever you are around the world, bring your team together on the same
whiteboard whatever device you use.

Design any workflow, wireframe or prototype, Ziteboard offers an infinite workplace for seeing the
big picture.

Boost any meeting, brainstorm, presentation, tutoring or training session.

Ziteboard is a visual collaboration platform improving the work for most remote teams, developers,
designers and making meetings, project planning and customer communication better.

## Insert images and PDF files

Drag-and-drop an image from another browser tab or use the file uploader from the Menu. For PDF
documents provide the page number or the range of the pages to be imported.

## Integrated board chat with audio and video capabilities

Distance learning becomes more convenient and personal as teachers and students engage face-to-face.
Enhance your learning experience with the integrated video chat feature on our whiteboard tool.

[Integrated video chat | Ziteboard.]

Initiate in-app voice and video chats effortlessly from the bottom left corner, enabling instant
visual communication for educators and private tutors. Students can join video calls with Free
accounts.

Ziteboard utilizes a lightning-fast peer-to-peer connection, ensuring participants stay connected
even with older devices.

[How does the voice and video chat work?][9]

## Cross Platform Compatibility

Access Ziteboard from any device with an internet connection, whether it's a desktop computer,
laptop, tablet or smartphone.

[Cross-platform compatible whiteboard.]

Our browser-based platform ensures seamless collaboration across different operating systems and
devices, including older models, thus ensuring that all users, especially students, can stay
connected and collaborate effectively regardless of the technology they have access to.

## Simplify Your Math Teaching with Math Tools

Empower your lessons with our Math Tools, designed for distant educators and tutors. The suite
includes the [Formula Editor][10] for effortlessly creating, editing, and displaying mathematical
formulas using LaTeX input or a user-friendly virtual keyboard, the [Graph Plotter][11] for
visualizing functions interactively, and the [Interactive Compass][12] for drawing precise circles
and arcs in geometry constructions.

[LaTeX Formula]

These tools are ideal for **private math tutors**, science educators, engineers, and anyone needing
to present complex equations, visualize graphs, or demonstrate geometry constructions with accuracy
and clarity. By using the Math Tools suite, you streamline your workflow, save time, and deliver
professional-quality content with ease.

## Export your whiteboard as a PDF or vector graphics

Export a **PNG** file if you quickly need a good quality image of the visible screen.

Export the whole board as a zoomable, **vector based SVG** file to feed Adobe Illustrator or any
image editor.

It's worth switching on the "Display A4 pages" option in the Settings before a lesson if you want to
export an already formatted **PDF document** at the end. Explore the options: [Export
whiteboard][13].

## Shared Whiteboard

Ziteboard serves as a versatile **shared whiteboard**, offering a touch-friendly online platform
accessible through any browser, as well as dedicated apps for iPad and Android. Its zoomable,
real-time canvas provides a seamless space for brainstorming, sketching, and collaborating with team

# Online Whiteboard with Realtime Collaboration

## Virtual online whiteboard with team collaboration

Ziteboard is a lightweight whiteboard website which works on any device: laptops, tablets, mobile
devices – optimized for both iPad's Safari and Google Chrome on laptops.

[START DRAWING NOW][8]

Our service is designed for successful realtime tutoring. We understand the importance of a clean
and easy to use interface to best serve both teachers and students of all ages. By design, this
lightweight yet powerful visual platform aims to provide a simple tool for distance education. Using
such a platform you have infinite space to work on with your student or class in realtime.

## Live Teamwork on Online Whiteboard

[Shared whiteboard to work together.]

Collaborate in real time, wherever you are around the world, bring your team together on the same
whiteboard whatever device you use.

Design any workflow, wireframe or prototype, Ziteboard offers an infinite workplace for seeing the
big picture.

Boost any meeting, brainstorm, presentation, tutoring or training session.

Ziteboard is a visual collaboration platform improving the work for most remote teams, developers,
designers and making meetings, project planning and customer communication better.

## Insert images and PDF files

Drag-and-drop an image from another browser tab or use the file uploader from the Menu. For PDF
documents provide the page number or the range of the pages to be imported.

## Integrated board chat with audio and video capabilities

Distance learning becomes more convenient and personal as teachers and students engage face-to-face.
Enhance your learning experience with the integrated video chat feature on our whiteboard tool.

[Integrated video chat | Ziteboard.]

Initiate in-app voice and video chats effortlessly from the bottom left corner, enabling instant
visual communication for educators and private tutors. Students can join video calls with Free
accounts.

Ziteboard utilizes a lightning-fast peer-to-peer connection, ensuring participants stay connected
even with older devices.

[How does the voice and video chat work?][9]

## Cross Platform Compatibility

Access Ziteboard from any device with an internet connection, whether it's a desktop computer,
laptop, tablet or smartphone.

[Cross-platform compatible whiteboard.]

Our browser-based platform ensures seamless collaboration across different operating systems and
devices, including older models, thus ensuring that all users, especially students, can stay
connected and collaborate effectively regardless of the technology they have access to.

## Simplify Your Math Teaching with Math Tools

Empower your lessons with our Math Tools, designed for distant educators and tutors. The suite
includes the [Formula Editor][10] for effortlessly creating, editing, and displaying mathematical
formulas using LaTeX input or a user-friendly virtual keyboard, the [Graph Plotter][11] for
visualizing functions interactively, and the [Interactive Compass][12] for drawing precise circles
and arcs in geometry constructions.

[LaTeX Formula]

These tools are ideal for **private math tutors**, science educators, engineers, and anyone needing
to present complex equations, visualize graphs, or demonstrate geometry constructions with accuracy
and clarity. By using the Math Tools suite, you streamline your workflow, save time, and deliver
professional-quality content with ease.

## Export your whiteboard as a PDF or vector graphics

Export a **PNG** file if you quickly need a good quality image of the visible screen.

Export the whole board as a zoomable, **vector based SVG** file to feed Adobe Illustrator or any
image editor.

It's worth switching on the "Display A4 pages" option in the Settings before a lesson if you want to
export an already formatted **PDF document** at the end. Explore the options: [Export
whiteboard][13].

Ziteboard serves as a versatile **shared whiteboard**, offering a touch-friendly online platform

This interactive, realtime, online collaboration tool lets you work better regardless wherever you
are in the World. Ziteboard is a clean collaboration software for businesses online and a simple,
free brainstorming, tutoring tool for education. It enables you and your friends colleagues to

Work together remotely, using a free online collaboration tool. Simply put: it is an online **team
collaboration tool** for remote teams.

## Wireframing Tool

Use the free whiteboard online for sketching up a new website, a smartphone app, a movie poster or
any other media. With freehand drawing and **line smoothing** all your scribbles will look perfect.
Need a perfect circle? Ziteboard will automatically recognize your intention and will display pretty
shapes so others are amazed by your drawing skills. Our **shape recognition** algorithm currently
supports lines, rectangles and circles. Invite your peers and start working visually together.

## One platform for every cab booking need

Whether you're booking a ride, managing corporate transportation, or expanding your transport
business, Zoyride brings riders, businesses, and transport suppliers together on one trusted
platform.
* ### For Riders
  
  Book outstation cabs, airport taxi, local city rides, and hourly car rental from verified

  needs through one platform. GST-compliant billing. One invoice.

* ### For Suppliers
  
  Grow your transport business by reaching riders and corporates actively searching for reliable cab
  services. Set your own fares. Fee drops as your rating rises.

How the marketplace works

## Zoyride sits in the middle — so everyone wins

We are the trusted mediator between demand and supply. Every booking is matched, verified, and
protected.
1. Demand

2. Trusted mediator

   assurance.
3. Verified supply

   their rating grows.

## Why riders choose Zoyride for cab booking online

Transparent fares, trusted suppliers, flexible payments, and smooth booking from start to finish.
* ### Zero Surcharge
  
  Suppliers set their own fares. Zoyride adds no surcharge. You always see the honest market rate —
  not a platform-inflated price.
* ### Verified Suppliers
  
  Every supplier is vetted, rated, and reviewed. Our rating system rewards quality — the better your
  service, the lower your fee.
* ### Quality Drives Reward
  
  Suppliers earn fee reductions through performance. 4★ rating = 5% fee. 5★ = just 2.5%. Great
  service costs less to list.

  monthly billing.
* ### Easy Cancellations
